schema_audit.verdict: NO OBSERVATION TIMESTAMP EXISTS ON ANY ROW. The only temporal field is `date`, date-granularity only (10 chars, no time component). There is no column recording WHEN the fact became knowable.

S3_split_reproduction.note: The split is not merely a category-name split: it is a SOURCE split. Every missed_game_* row comes from an espn_summary_<eventid>.json boxscore; every other row comes from a bbref_transactions_<year>.html page. The two regimes have disjoint provenance.

explanation_of_the_19_non_contract_rows.meaning: the Commissioner's Cup final is outside the contract team-game universe; those 19 rows describe a game the program does not model. They are not a join defect.

regime_R_realised_participation.producer_evidence: scrape_injury_history.py parse_espn_dnp() reads boxscore.players[].statistics[].athletes[] and keeps rows where ath['didNotPlay'] is truthy, then stamps the row with g['date'] -- the date of that same game. The record's ONLY evidentiary source is the completed game's own boxscore.
regime_R_realised_participation.why_not_a_pregame_feature: A didNotPlay flag in a boxscore is a realised participation outcome of the target game, observable only after the game has been played. Its date is the target game's own date by construction, so no lag exists between the observation and the event it describes. Using it on the target-game row is target-adjacent leakage of exactly the kind Severity A names.
regime_R_realised_participation.lagged_use_status: LAGGED USE NOT ADJUDICATED HERE. Strictly-earlier-game aggregates of these rows are a different object with a different (and separately unproven) cutoff argument; this node classifies the TARGET-GAME row only, and does not license lagged construction.

provenance_defects.consequence: project_docs/INJURY_HISTORY.md states that every HTTP payload is kept under data/injury_history/raw/ and that manifest.jsonl records url/status/time per fetch. Neither the directory nor the manifest exists in this worktree, and .gitignore line 7 excludes 'data/injury_history/raw/' from version control. The 'no source timestamp' verdict is therefore not recoverable by further work inside this repository.
